game: Mortal Kombat II (Genesis), Liu Kang vs the CPU
question: {situation} Which move do you use?

situations.enemy_jump: The enemy is in the air, less than 150 px away.
situations.close_attack: The enemy is attacking, less than 100 px away.
situations.far_attack: The enemy is attacking from more than 100 px away, maybe with a projectile.
situations.point_blank: The enemy is less than 60 px away and not attacking.
situations.close: The enemy is 60 to 80 px away and not attacking.
situations.mid: The enemy is 80 to 100 px away and not attacking.
situations.far: The enemy is 100 to 150 px away and not attacking.
situations.full_screen: The enemy is more than 150 px away and not attacking.

moves.jump_in: Jump toward the enemy. Easy to punish if the enemy is ready.
moves.block: Stand and block. Stops high and mid attacks.
moves.crouch_block: Crouch and block. Stops low attacks.
moves.duck: Crouch without blocking. High projectiles fly over you.
moves.high_punch: Fast high punch. Reach 70 px. Under 50 px it becomes a throw, which beats blocking.
moves.uppercut: Crouching uppercut. Reach 70 px. Big damage, beats a jump-in.
moves.sweep: Back + low kick. Reach 94 px. Knocks the enemy down.
moves.roundhouse: Back + high kick. Reach 75 px. Knocks the enemy away.
moves.fireball_high: High fireball. Hits at any distance. 17 damage.
moves.fireball_low: Low fireball. Hits at any distance. 17 damage.
moves.flying_kick: Flying kick. Crosses 100 to 150 px fast. 20 damage.
